label: Creator organisation
definition: Name of the organisation that produced the delivery.

label: Creator e-mail address
definition: Contact address of the creator organisation.

label: Language
definition: Language or languages of the delivery.

label: Licence
definition: Licence under which the delivery is published.

label: Rights

label: Licence document
definition: Document stating the licence, where it is not one of the standard licences.

label: Metadata document
definition: Document holding further metadata about the delivery.
